canonical_data: Markdown memory directories, saved sessions, and a per-user ohmo workspace on local disk, with settings in layered JSON files
current_repo_note: Covers both the OpenHarness harness and the ohmo personal agent built on it, which live in one repository and one package. The README's subscription bridges read the Claude Code and Codex credential files on the same machine, so use through them is governed by those vendors' own terms, which are not reviewed here.
strengths: A readable, documented implementation of the whole harness pattern, with the agent loop, permission modes, path and command rules, hooks, and a Docker sandbox as separate modules rather than one opaque binary
ohmo adds a real persistent-agent layer: a gateway with channel adapters for ten chat, messaging, and email services, a workspace, and session and memory storage
Edits preview a diff before they apply and a person can approve once or for the rest of the session
weaknesses: The package is at version 0.1.9, was created in April 2026, and its last push was in June 2026, so the harness is young and has been quiet for months
The tool names, slash commands, and CLAUDE.md handling mirror another vendor's agent CLI, so behaviour is shaped by that tool's conventions and the project positions itself for study and extension
Its easiest setup runs through the user's existing Claude Code or Codex subscription credentials, which ties day-to-day use to those vendors' terms
why_it_matters: A heavily starred open implementation that makes the structure of a production agent harness inspectable and extendable, with a persistent chat-channel agent built on the same core.
